pretreatments.description: Milling of pine wood chips to reduce particle size to less than 1 mm.
Alkali pretreatment with 8% sodium hydroxide (NaOH) solution at room temperature for 10 minutes.
Incubation of the NaOH-treated pine wood at 100 °C for 10 minutes, mixed every 10 minutes.
Incubation of the NaOH-treated pine wood at 100 °C for 30 minutes, mixed every 10 minutes.
Incubation of the NaOH-treated pine wood at 100 °C for 60 minutes, mixed every 10 minutes.
Incubation of the NaOH-treated pine wood at 0 °C for 10 minutes, mixed every 10 minutes.
Incubation of the NaOH-treated pine wood at 0 °C for 30 minutes, mixed every 10 minutes.
Incubation of the NaOH-treated pine wood at 0 °C for 60 minutes, mixed every 10 minutes.
Centrifugation at 4500 rpm (5000 g) for 10 minutes to separate solids.
Washing of the settled solids with distilled water followed by vacuum filtration until pH 7 was achieved.
Keeping the washed solids in plastic bags at 4 °C until use.
Anaerobic batch digestion of the treated and untreated pine woods at mesophilic conditions (37 °C) using inoculum from a large-scale biogas bioreactor.
